$$F = h(b) := \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 + Ab^4}} + kBb^3.$$

$$\frac{2Ab^3}{(1+Ab^4)^{3/2}} = 3kBb^2 \quad\Longrightarrow\quad k = \frac{2Ab}{3B(1+Ab^4)^{3/2}}.$$

At a critical point with $u = Ab^4$, the minimum value is
$$h_{\min} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1+u}} + \frac{2u}{3(1+u)^{3/2}} = \frac{1 + \frac{5}{3}u}{(1+u)^{3/2}}.$$

$$k(\lambda) = \frac{A^{3/4}}{3\sqrt{2}\,B} = \frac{[3(1+\lambda^4)]^{3/4}}{3\sqrt{2}\,(\lambda^4 + \lambda^{-1})} = \frac{\lambda(1+\lambda^4)^{3/4}}{3^{1/4}\sqrt{2}\,(1+\lambda^5)}.$$
